newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin Airport passengers up 16 pct y/y in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Dublin Airport passengers up 16 pct y/y in Nov.

text.p: The number of passengers travelling through Dublin Airport grew by 16 percent year-on-year in November to 629,026, the Irish airports authority, Aer Rianta, said on Thursday.
Traffic to and from Britain grew by 19 percent on last November's levels while transatlantic traffic was up 38 percent, thanks to an American football game played in Dublin last month.
European traffic was up by four percent and domestic traffic grew by two percent, Aer Rianta said in a statement.
"Dublin Airport is enjoying yet another record year and is very much on target to reach nine million passengers for the first time ever in a single year in 1996," Aer Rianta said.
